newsitem.title: USA: You must remember this - new Humphrey Bogart stamp.
newsitem.headline: You must remember this - new Humphrey Bogart stamp.

text.p: He was many things on screen -- tough detective Sam Spade, cafe owner Rick in "Casablanca," a leech-ridden boat captain in "The African Queen" -- but on Thursday Humphrey Bogart became a stamp.
In a ceremony outside the legendary Mann's Chinese Theatre on Hollywood Boulevard, the new postage stamp featuring the Hollywood legend was unveiled.
The 32-cent stamp bearing Bogart's rugged good looks in a still from "The Big Sleep" marks the third time a movie star has graced a U.S. postage stamp.

Bogart joins Marilyn Monroe and James Dean in the Postal Service's "Legends of Hollywood" series. The first batch of 195 million Bogart stamps were going on sale at more than 40,000 post offices across the country.
Bogart's widow Lauren Bacall attended Thursday's ceremony and said "Bogey" would have given it his stamp of approval.
"I'm very honoured on his behalf," she said. "I know how surprised he would have been that an event like this would take place in his honour."
Also present were the couple's two children, Stephen and Leslie, along with actress Anjelica Huston, whose father John directed Bogart in "The Maltese Falcon" and "The African Queen" among others.
